name: Makuruwan Arithmetic Human Quiz
author: cletous

sections.description:
Makuruwan Arithmetic Human Quiz adds a lightweight arithmetic human-verification challenge to WordPress login, standard WordPress comments, WooCommerce product reviews, and custom forms. It helps keep bots out without relying on Google reCAPTCHA or external services.

Comment and product-review protection is enforced server-side on the normal WordPress comment submission endpoint, so simply removing the visible quiz field does not bypass the check.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/makuruwan-arithmetic-human-quiz/ and activate it.
  2. Go to Settings → Human Quiz to configure the quiz.
  3. Enable or disable protection separately for login, blog/post comments, and WooCommerce product reviews.
  4. To protect custom forms, add the shortcode [makarhq_human_check] inside your <form> markup.
sections.faq:
Can I protect only the login form?

Yes. You can enable or disable login protection in the plugin settings.

What shortcode should I use in custom forms?

Use [makarhq_human_check] inside your <form> tag so the fields are submitted with the form.

Does it protect WordPress comments?

Yes. Version 1.1.0 can require the arithmetic challenge before a visitor submits a normal WordPress comment.

Does it protect WooCommerce product reviews?

Yes. Product review forms can be protected independently from normal blog/post comments.

Are logged-in users also asked to solve the quiz on comments and reviews?

Yes. When comment or product-review protection is enabled, the challenge is rendered for both logged-in and logged-out users using the standard WordPress comment form hooks.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Added arithmetic-quiz protection for standard WordPress comments.
  • Added separate arithmetic-quiz protection for WooCommerce product reviews.
  • Enforced comment/review validation server-side so direct form POSTs cannot bypass the quiz.
  • Added separate settings toggles for comments and product reviews, enabled by default.
  • Corrected activation-hook registration so plugin defaults are reliably created.
  • Corrected the public helper access used for custom-form error messages.

1.0.2

  • Updated prefixes and text domain to comply with WordPress.org guidelines.
  • Improved input sanitization and escaping for Plugin Check.

1.0.1

  • Initial public release.
